svg.title: 今夜有灯：灯一直为你亮着
svg.desc: 冷蓝星空窗外，整屋蜂蜜暖光里，一位成年人和普通家猫坐在已经备好晚饭的低桌前。
svg.metadata: Formal UI V1.2-A master v2. Original editable vector artwork. No embedded raster content. User reference is used only for approved composition, lighting, warmth and dinner semantics; all paths, gradients and textures are redrawn.

g.inkscape:label: 30 Warm edge balance no black corners
